name: Colin Drew Claus
biography: Craig's cousin, son of Bud and Marylou Claus. He married Valerie Ann Bean, and their children are Marissa Shawn Claus Deyong and Jarad Thomas Claus. Marissa married Adam Isaac Deyong (who died March 6, 2021), and their children are Anna Sophia and Jonah Simon Deyong.
